params.markdown:
# Tenant & Service Cost Attribution
Attributes shared data stream costs (such as `organization.id`, `service.name`, or `labels.team`) alongside zero-query dedicated namespaces into a single unified `tenant_id` bill with decoupled indexing, storage, and query shares.

FROM chargeback_lookup.cluster_sub_attribution
| WHERE @timestamp IS NOT NULL AND tenant_id IS NOT NULL
| EVAL ts = @timestamp, ck = composite_key::keyword, ck_ds = composite_datastream_key::keyword, sub_dep_id = deployment_id, sub_dep_name = deployment_name, sub_ds = datastream, sub_field = attribution_field, sub_source = attribution_source, sub_sto_mode = storage_share_source, sub_qry_mode = query_share_source

| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.cluster_datastream_contribution ON ck_ds == composite_datastream_key
| DROP composite_key, composite_datastream_key, cluster_name, deployment_id, datastream, ds_type, ds_namespace, usage_source, @timestamp, event.ingested
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.cluster_deployment_contribution ON ck == composite_key
| DROP composite_key, cluster_name, deployment_id, usage_source, @timestamp, event.ingested
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.billing_realized_pool ON ck == composite_key
| EVAL bill_dep_name = deployment_name, bill_is_onprem = COALESCE(is_onprem, false)
| DROP composite_key, deployment_id, deployment_name, deployment_group, @timestamp, event.ingested
| WHERE data_tier_capacity_ecu IS NOT NULL
| LOOKUP JOIN cluster_capacity_utilization_lookup ON ck == composite_key
| DROP composite_key, cluster_name, deployment_id, @timestamp, event.ingested
| EVAL cloud_cfg_key = "chargeback_config"
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.chargeback_conf ON cloud_cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL cloud_rate = conf_chargeable_unit_rate, cloud_unit = conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit, c_idx_w = TO_DOUBLE(conf_indexing_weight), c_qry_w = TO_DOUBLE(conf_query_weight), c_sto_w = TO_DOUBLE(conf_storage_weight), c_mem_w = TO_DOUBLE(conf_utilization_memory_weight), c_disk_w = TO_DOUBLE(conf_utilization_storage_weight), c_util_floor = TO_DOUBLE(conf_utilization_floor)
| DROP config_join_key, conf_start_date, conf_end_date, conf_chargeable_unit_rate, conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit, conf_indexing_weight, conf_query_weight, conf_storage_weight, conf_utilization_memory_weight, conf_utilization_storage_weight, conf_utilization_floor, event.ingested
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.chargeback_currency ON cloud_cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL cloud_sym = conf_currency_symbol, cloud_sym_unit = conf_currency_unit
| DROP cloud_cfg_key, config_join_key, conf_start_date, conf_end_date, conf_currency_symbol, conf_currency_unit, event.ingested
| EVAL onprem_cfg_key = CASE(bill_is_onprem, "chargeback_config_onprem", null)
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.chargeback_conf ON onprem_cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL onprem_rate = conf_chargeable_unit_rate, onprem_unit = conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit, o_idx_w = TO_DOUBLE(conf_indexing_weight), o_qry_w = TO_DOUBLE(conf_query_weight), o_sto_w = TO_DOUBLE(conf_storage_weight), o_mem_w = TO_DOUBLE(conf_utilization_memory_weight), o_disk_w = TO_DOUBLE(conf_utilization_storage_weight), o_util_floor = TO_DOUBLE(conf_utilization_floor)
| DROP config_join_key, conf_start_date, conf_end_date, conf_chargeable_unit_rate, conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit, conf_indexing_weight, conf_query_weight, conf_storage_weight, conf_utilization_memory_weight, conf_utilization_storage_weight, conf_utilization_floor, event.ingested
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.chargeback_currency ON onprem_cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL onprem_sym = conf_currency_symbol, onprem_sym_unit = conf_currency_unit
| DROP onprem_cfg_key, config_join_key, conf_start_date, conf_end_date, conf_currency_symbol, conf_currency_unit, event.ingested
| EVAL _c_unit = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(cloud_unit)), null), _c_sym_u = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_sym_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(cloud_sym_unit)), null), _o_has_row = (onprem_rate IS NOT NULL), _o_unit = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(onprem_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(onprem_unit)), null), _o_sym_u = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(onprem_sym_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(onprem_sym_unit)), null)
| EVAL _c_sym = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_sym)) > 0 AND (_c_sym_u IS NULL OR _c_sym_u == COALESCE(_c_unit, "EUR")), TRIM(cloud_sym), null), _o_eff_u = COALESCE(_o_unit, _c_unit, "EUR")
| EVAL _o_sym = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(onprem_sym)) > 0 AND (_o_sym_u IS NULL OR _o_sym_u == _o_eff_u), TRIM(onprem_sym), null), rate = CASE(bill_is_onprem, COALESCE(onprem_rate, 0.00085), COALESCE(cloud_rate, 0.85)), unit = CASE(bill_is_onprem, _o_eff_u, COALESCE(_c_unit, "EUR"))
| EVAL idx_w = CASE(bill_is_onprem, COALESCE(o_idx_w, c_idx_w, 20.0), COALESCE(c_idx_w, 20.0)), qry_w = CASE(bill_is_onprem, COALESCE(o_qry_w, c_qry_w, 20.0), COALESCE(c_qry_w, 20.0)), sto_w = CASE(bill_is_onprem, COALESCE(o_sto_w, c_sto_w, 40.0), COALESCE(c_sto_w, 40.0)), mem_w = CASE(bill_is_onprem, COALESCE(o_mem_w, c_mem_w, 70.0), COALESCE(c_mem_w, 70.0)), disk_w = CASE(bill_is_onprem, COALESCE(o_disk_w, c_disk_w, 30.0), COALESCE(c_disk_w, 30.0)), util_floor = CASE(bill_is_onprem, COALESCE(o_util_floor, c_util_floor, 0.10), COALESCE(c_util_floor, 0.10))
| EVAL _def_sym = CASE(unit == "USD", "$", unit == "GBP", "£", unit == "ZAR", "R", "€")
| EVAL sym = CASE(bill_is_onprem, CASE(_o_sym IS NOT NULL, _o_sym, _o_has_row AND _o_unit IS NULL AND _c_sym IS NOT NULL, _c_sym, _c_sym IS NOT NULL AND _c_unit == unit, _c_sym, _def_sym), CASE(_c_sym IS NOT NULL, _c_sym, _def_sym))
| EVAL Currency = CONCAT(sym, " ", unit)
| EVAL heap_util = COALESCE(heap_used_pct_p95, 100.0) / 100.0, disk_util = COALESCE(disk_used_pct_p95, 100.0) / 100.0
| EVAL raw_util_score = CASE(mem_w + disk_w > 0.0, (mem_w * heap_util + disk_w * disk_util) / (mem_w + disk_w), 1.0)
| EVAL capacity_utilization_score = CASE(raw_util_score < util_floor, util_floor, raw_util_score)

| EVAL eff_sto_w = CASE(COALESCE(deployment_sum_data_set_store_size, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(deployment_sum_store_size, 0) > 0, sto_w, 0.0), eff_qry_w = CASE(COALESCE(deployment_sum_query_time, 0) > 0, qry_w, 0.0), eff_idx_w = CASE(COALESCE(deployment_sum_indexing_time, 0) > 0, idx_w, 0.0)
| EVAL total_weight = eff_sto_w + eff_qry_w + eff_idx_w
| EVAL ds_idx_pool_cost = CASE(total_weight > 0.0, (ds_idx_ecu * eff_idx_w / total_weight) * rate, 0.0), ds_qry_pool_cost = CASE(total_weight > 0.0, (ds_qry_ecu * eff_qry_w / total_weight) * rate, 0.0), ds_sto_pool_cost = CASE(total_weight > 0.0, (ds_sto_ecu * eff_sto_w / total_weight) * rate, 0.0)
| EVAL s_ing = COALESCE(ingest_share_pct, 0.0), s_sto = COALESCE(storage_share_pct, ingest_share_pct, 0.0)
| EVAL s_qry = COALESCE(query_share_pct, 0.5 * s_ing + 0.5 * s_sto)
| EVAL tenant_idx_cost = ds_idx_pool_cost * s_ing, tenant_qry_cost = ds_qry_pool_cost * s_qry, tenant_sto_cost = ds_sto_pool_cost * s_sto, tenant_blended_cost = ds_idx_pool_cost * s_ing + ds_qry_pool_cost * s_qry + ds_sto_pool_cost * s_sto
| WHERE tenant_blended_cost > 0.0
| INLINE STATS _n_cur = COUNT_DISTINCT(Currency)
| EVAL tenant_lbl = CASE(_n_cur > 1, CONCAT(tenant_id, " (", Currency, ")"), tenant_id)
| STATS `Attributed Cost` = SUM(tenant_blended_cost) BY ts, tenant_lbl
| RENAME ts AS `@timestamp`, tenant_lbl AS `Tenant / Service`
| SORT `@timestamp` DESC, `Attributed Cost` DESC
| LIMIT 10000

| EVAL _c_unit = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(cloud_unit)), null), _c_sym_u = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_sym_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(cloud_sym_unit)), null), _o_has_row = (onprem_rate IS NOT NULL), _o_unit = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(onprem_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(onprem_unit)), null), _o_sym_u = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(onprem_sym_unit)) > 0, TO_UPPER(TRIM(onprem_sym_unit)), null)
| EVAL _c_sym = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(cloud_sym)) > 0 AND (_c_sym_u IS NULL OR _c_sym_u == COALESCE(_c_unit, "EUR")), TRIM(cloud_sym), null), _o_eff_u = COALESCE(_o_unit, _c_unit, "EUR")
| EVAL _o_sym = CASE(LENGTH(TRIM(onprem_sym)) > 0 AND (_o_sym_u IS NULL OR _o_sym_u == _o_eff_u), TRIM(onprem_sym), null), rate = CASE(bill_is_onprem, COALESCE(onprem_rate, 0.00085), COALESCE(cloud_rate, 0.85)), unit = CASE(bill_is_onprem, _o_eff_u, COALESCE(_c_unit, "EUR"))
| EVAL idx_w = CASE(bill_is_onprem, COALESCE(o_idx_w, c_idx_w, 20.0), COALESCE(c_idx_w, 20.0)), qry_w = CASE(bill_is_onprem, COALESCE(o_qry_w, c_qry_w, 20.0), COALESCE(c_qry_w, 20.0)), sto_w = CASE(bill_is_onprem, COALESCE(o_sto_w, c_sto_w, 40.0), COALESCE(c_sto_w, 40.0)), mem_w = CASE(bill_is_onprem, COALESCE(o_mem_w, c_mem_w, 70.0), COALESCE(c_mem_w, 70.0)), disk_w = CASE(bill_is_onprem, COALESCE(o_disk_w, c_disk_w, 30.0), COALESCE(c_disk_w, 30.0)), util_floor = CASE(bill_is_onprem, COALESCE(o_util_floor, c_util_floor, 0.10), COALESCE(c_util_floor, 0.10))
| EVAL _def_sym = CASE(unit == "USD", "$", unit == "GBP", "£", unit == "ZAR", "R", "€")
| EVAL sym = CASE(bill_is_onprem, CASE(_o_sym IS NOT NULL, _o_sym, _o_has_row AND _o_unit IS NULL AND _c_sym IS NOT NULL, _c_sym, _c_sym IS NOT NULL AND _c_unit == unit, _c_sym, _def_sym), CASE(_c_sym IS NOT NULL, _c_sym, _def_sym))
| EVAL Currency = CONCAT(sym, " ", unit)
| EVAL heap_util = COALESCE(heap_used_pct_p95, 100.0) / 100.0, disk_util = COALESCE(disk_used_pct_p95, 100.0) / 100.0
| EVAL raw_util_score = CASE(mem_w + disk_w > 0.0, (mem_w * heap_util + disk_w * disk_util) / (mem_w + disk_w), 1.0)
| EVAL capacity_utilization_score = CASE(raw_util_score < util_floor, util_floor, raw_util_score)
| EVAL chargeable_pool = data_tier_capacity_ecu * COALESCE(capacity_utilization_score, 1.0)
| EVAL ds_idx_ecu = COALESCE(CASE(deployment_sum_indexing_time > 0, TO_DOUBLE(datastream_sum_indexing_time) / deployment_sum_indexing_time * chargeable_pool), 0.0), ds_qry_ecu = COALESCE(CASE(deployment_sum_query_time > 0, TO_DOUBLE(datastream_sum_query_time) / deployment_sum_query_time * chargeable_pool), 0.0), ds_sto_ecu = CASE(COALESCE(deployment_sum_data_set_store_size, 0) > COALESCE(deployment_sum_store_size, 0), COALESCE(CASE(deployment_sum_data_set_store_size > 0, TO_DOUBLE(datastream_sum_data_set_store_size) / deployment_sum_data_set_store_size * chargeable_pool), 0.0), COALESCE(CASE(deployment_sum_store_size > 0, TO_DOUBLE(datastream_sum_store_size) / deployment_sum_store_size * chargeable_pool), 0.0))
| EVAL eff_sto_w = CASE(COALESCE(deployment_sum_data_set_store_size, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(deployment_sum_store_size, 0) > 0, sto_w, 0.0), eff_qry_w = CASE(COALESCE(deployment_sum_query_time, 0) > 0, qry_w, 0.0), eff_idx_w = CASE(COALESCE(deployment_sum_indexing_time, 0) > 0, idx_w, 0.0)
| EVAL total_weight = eff_sto_w + eff_qry_w + eff_idx_w
| EVAL ds_idx_pool_cost = CASE(total_weight > 0.0, (ds_idx_ecu * eff_idx_w / total_weight) * rate, 0.0), ds_qry_pool_cost = CASE(total_weight > 0.0, (ds_qry_ecu * eff_qry_w / total_weight) * rate, 0.0), ds_sto_pool_cost = CASE(total_weight > 0.0, (ds_sto_ecu * eff_sto_w / total_weight) * rate, 0.0)
| EVAL s_ing = COALESCE(ingest_share_pct, 0.0), s_sto = COALESCE(storage_share_pct, ingest_share_pct, 0.0)
| EVAL s_qry = COALESCE(query_share_pct, 0.5 * s_ing + 0.5 * s_sto)
| EVAL tenant_idx_cost = ds_idx_pool_cost * s_ing, tenant_qry_cost = ds_qry_pool_cost * s_qry, tenant_sto_cost = ds_sto_pool_cost * s_sto, tenant_blended_cost = ds_idx_pool_cost * s_ing + ds_qry_pool_cost * s_qry + ds_sto_pool_cost * s_sto
| WHERE tenant_blended_cost > 0.0
| EVAL _raw_dep = COALESCE(sub_dep_name, bill_dep_name, sub_dep_id, "unknown"), deployment = CASE(sub_dep_id IS NULL, COALESCE(sub_dep_name, bill_dep_name, "unknown"), CONCAT(COALESCE(sub_dep_name, bill_dep_name, sub_dep_id), " (", LEFT(sub_dep_id, 6), ")"))
| STATS `Ingest Share %` = CASE(SUM(ds_idx_pool_cost) > 0.0, SUM(tenant_idx_cost) / SUM(ds_idx_pool_cost) * 100.0, AVG(s_ing) * 100.0), `Storage Share %` = CASE(SUM(ds_sto_pool_cost) > 0.0, SUM(tenant_sto_cost) / SUM(ds_sto_pool_cost) * 100.0, AVG(s_sto) * 100.0), `Query Share %` = CASE(SUM(ds_qry_pool_cost) > 0.0, SUM(tenant_qry_cost) / SUM(ds_qry_pool_cost) * 100.0, AVG(s_qry) * 100.0), `Indexing Cost` = SUM(tenant_idx_cost), `Query Cost` = SUM(tenant_qry_cost), `Storage Cost` = SUM(tenant_sto_cost), `Attributed Cost` = SUM(tenant_blended_cost) BY deployment, sub_ds, tenant_id, sub_field, sub_source, sub_sto_mode, sub_qry_mode, Currency
| RENAME deployment AS `Deployment`, sub_ds AS `Data Stream`, tenant_id AS `Tenant / Service`, sub_field AS `Field`, sub_source AS `Source`, sub_sto_mode AS `Storage Mode`, sub_qry_mode AS `Query Source`
| SORT `Attributed Cost` DESC
| LIMIT 5000
